question: Does an exact first-party Velvia 100 reversal characteristic-curve observation improve held-group source-only prediction of the retained CB4 dye coordinates beyond the closed CB5 affine family?

source_observation.trace_method: Human-guided source-ink trace frozen before any CB6 fit or score; values are graph observations, not fitted AQ1 measurements.

evaluation.folds: all 6 test_set x 5 slide_index joint leave-one-set-and-slide-out folds
evaluation.freshness: mechanism-new but all AQ1 rows were consumed previously; exact held grouping is not a pristine population confirmation

candidate.latent_exposure: three positive affine mixtures of [1,R,G,B], with offset constrained to the traced log-exposure domain
candidate.development: fixed monotone PCHIP interpolation of the three frozen first-party characteristic traces
candidate.dye_assignment: blue-sensitive to yellow, green-sensitive to magenta, red-sensitive to cyan
candidate.fit: one deterministic bounded least-squares solve per fold; 16 fitted scalars total, equal to CB5's coefficient count
candidate.output: 29-sample optical-density spectrum on 410..690nm through the exact retained Velvia 100 dye basis

controls.cb5_nonnegative_affine: exact four-feature CB5 correct-basis family refit on the same development rows
controls.direct_nonnegative_spectral: same CB5 four source features fitted independently to each target density sample
controls.cyclic_layer_assignment: same fitted physical coefficients with yellow/magenta/cyan assignment cyclically permuted
controls.target_oracle: CB4 per-row target-consuming coefficient fit, diagnostic ceiling only

stop_rules: Do not change trace points, curve interpolation, parameter count, initialization, bounds, folds, controls or gates after formal scoring.
Failure closes this exact first-party-characteristic constrained forward family without curve refitting, polynomial residuals, multiple starts, extra layers, row rescue or threshold relaxation.
Pass remains an internal manufactured-target mechanism result and cannot establish camera-to-film, independent-roll, photographic or product behaviour.
claim_ceiling: Internal test of a first-party Velvia 100 characteristic-curve prior on existing manufactured-target recorder/measurement rows; not Velvia 100F calibration, camera RGB, scene exposure, independent roll/process, photographic appearance or product profile.
